note: Hashtags for the daily @matchamap.app posts (tools/social/plan.js). Every caption gets the three 'always' tags, the two city tags ({city} is the city name in lower case letters and digits) and two from 'rotating', picked by the date and the item's place in the day, so the set changes daily and a re-run of a date gives the same tags. 5 to 8 in all. Keep every tag free of the banned words in plan.js.
